Loss report: gitlab -> tekton
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/nightly/step/script step.image: default image (the step names no image and Tekton requires one; alpine:3.22 runs it)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/nightly/step/script step.shell: bash-if-present preamble in the script (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the script starts with a line that re-runs it under bash -e when the image has bash, else it runs under sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/nightly/step/source-checkout step.action: StepAction ref to the tektoncd-catalog git-clone through the git resolver (the ctx-repo and ctx-sha params carry the repository and the commit)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.schedule: CronJob posting to the EventListener (CronJob gitlab-ci-schedule-0 posts to el-pipemaster-schedule in namespace default; deploy both in that namespace, or edit the host. The post has an empty body, so every ctx-* param is empty and a clone step has no repository. The entry matches only the X-Pipemaster-Schedule header, so any pod that reaches the service of listener pipemaster-schedule can start a run. The listener has no Ingress, and the webhook listener pipemaster does not take schedule entries. Do not expose pipemaster-schedule, and limit it with a NetworkPolicy that admits only the CronJob pods)
